[[Hall of Fame Tip Off]] champion |bowl=[[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2016–17 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Duke University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by a 37th-year head coach, [[Mike Krzyzewski]]. Starting on January 7, [[Jeff Capel]] temporarily took over coaching duties while Krzyzewski recovered from lower back surgery.{{cite web|url=http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=4200&ATCLID=211387896|title=Krzyzewski to Undergo Lower Back Surgery|date=January 2, 2017|work=GoDuke.com|publisher=Duke Sports Information|access-date=January 2, 2017}} The Blue Devils played their home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]] as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 28–9, 11–7 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in fifth place. They became the first ACC team to win four games in four days on their way to winning the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received the ACC's automatic bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Troy Trojans men's basketball team|Troy]] in the first round to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2016–17 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]]. ==Previous season== Duke advanced to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|Sweet Sixteen]] a year after winning its fifth national championship. The Blue Devils beat UNC-Wilmington and Yale before falling to top seeded Oregon in the West region.{{cite web|url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/duke/article68195347.html|title=Duke's season ends in Sweet 16 with 82-68 loss to Oregon|last=Keeley|first=Laura|date=March 25, 2016|publisher=[[The News & Observer]]|access-date=August 21, 2024}} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
